about: Every generated dataset: what it is, how it was made, where it lives. One entry per release or abandoned batch; status released | superseded | incomplete. Update it in the same commit as the HANDOFF entry. location.host is an SSH alias from the maintainers' ~/.ssh/config.

datasets.name: g1d_shenzhen_pour_beans_cup_or_mug_500
datasets.format: LeRobot v3.0 from scripts/datagen/export.py (XPolicyLab converter); instruction names the target: short measuring cup or white mug
datasets.acceptance: all_beans_retained_any_target_v2 (300-600 beans; whole episode: cups never touch, target <= 15 deg, distractors move <= 2 cm; last 30 frames all beans in the target, both cups <= 15 deg); 505 of 751 attempts; targets 257 measuring cup / 243 mug
datasets.assets: measuring cups measured 2026-10-19, plastic_mug generated on 5090-2, 5.6 mm PBD beans, 2-5 distractors from 19 Clutter categories (read-only copy of the shared library)
datasets.code: 1d39c9d (branch commit before the rebase onto main)
datasets.layouts: 1100 candidates in g1d_shenzhen_lab/10 from scripts/g1d/prepare_bean_pour_layouts.py (random hand, both yaws, mug handle toward the holding fingers +-40 deg, bean targets 350-630), sharded into seeds 500-521, split=train
datasets.published: ModelScope dataset ChongZheng/g1d_shenzhen_pour_beans_cup_or_mug_500 (private), 50 data files checked against local size and sha256
datasets.validation: export read-back 500 / 199697; audit.py recomputed acceptance for 500/500, distinct layouts; open-loop replay of 8 episodes: arm state within 2e-3 rad, 6 reaccepted, 2 diverged in the granular beans

datasets.name: g1d_office_pour_beans_random_hand_yaw_100
datasets.format: legacy, as g1d_office_pour_all_red_beans_measuring_cups_100: LeRobot v3.0 from scripts/g1d/export_office_beans.py, image keys cam_head / cam_left_wrist / cam_right_wrist, gripper state measured, custom task string
datasets.acceptance: all_beans_retained_v2 (672 beans); 104 of 176 attempts (left hand 53, right 51); the earliest 50 per hand selected
datasets.assets: as the measured-cup dataset: measuring cups measured 2026-10-19, 5.6 mm PBD beans of 0.1 g
datasets.code: a1b6db5 (random pouring hand, cup yaw via scripted_demo.flat_turn, cavity-based pour loop)
datasets.layouts: 400 layouts, hand balanced 200 / 200, 6-D Latin hypercube: tall cup |x| 0.05-0.22 m, short cup |x| 0.05-0.18 m, y -0.46..-0.28 m, both yaws 0-90 deg; in that run's Assets, not marked split=train
datasets.published: ModelScope dataset ChongZheng/g1d_office_pour_beans_random_hand_yaw_100 (private), 17 data files checked against local sha256
datasets.validation: exporter read-back 100 / 39827; recount of all 67200 beans over each episode's last 30 frames, none left or spilled; 20-bin coverage of the four position coordinates and 18 yaw bins; max final-second cup tilt 29.88 deg; LeRobot reader decoded 600 first/last frames

datasets.name: g1d_office_pour_all_red_beans_measuring_cups_100
datasets.format: legacy: LeRobot v3.0 from scripts/g1d/export_office_beans.py, not the XPolicyLab converter. Image keys observation.images.cam_head / cam_left_wrist / cam_right_wrist (converter: cam_high for the head), robot_type unitree_g1d_dex1, joint names as motor names, H.264. State and action as in CONTRACT.md (left arm 7, left gripper, right arm 7, right gripper; gripper state measured). Task string 'Pour all red beans from the tall measuring cup into the short measuring cup.' differs from the eval instruction.
datasets.acceptance: all_beans_retained_v2: all 672 beans in the short cup, none left or spilled, both cups within 30 deg of upright for 30 frames; 108 of 118 attempts
datasets.assets: measuring cups measured 2026-10-19 (140 / 170 mm, 40 / 60 g); red beans as 5.6 mm PBD spheres of 0.1 g
datasets.code: git archive 269898c with scripts/g1d/scripted_demo.py from a83d4f4 (C2C_RIM_DOWN measuring cup 0.045)
datasets.layouts: candidates g1d/9 (400, 4-D Latin hypercube, random seed 20261019) sharded into g1d/100-107 of the run's own Assets copy; not marked split=train (made before split.json); the office eval layouts g1d/0-2 come from build_asset.py and were not used
datasets.published: ModelScope dataset ChongZheng/g1d_office_pour_all_red_beans_measuring_cups_100 (private), 16 data files checked against local sha256
datasets.validation: exporter read-back 100 / 40279 frames; independent recount of every bean over each episode's last 30 frames; LeRobot 0.4.4 loader decoded first and last frame of every episode (final_validation.json, sha256.json in the dataset)

datasets.name: g1d_office_pour_all_red_beans_old_cups
datasets.format: legacy raw episodes (trajectory.npz, MP4, quality.json), 106 accepted; the LeRobot export stopped at 8 of 100
datasets.acceptance: all_beans_retained_v2 with 1840 4 mm beans; 106 of 141 attempts
datasets.assets: measuring cups from photos before measurement (135 / 158 mm), 4 mm red beans
datasets.layouts: g1d/9 candidates, seeds 100-107 in that run's Assets
datasets.notes: Replaced by g1d_office_pour_all_red_beans_measuring_cups_100. Its final-audit process waits for an export that will not finish and has to be stopped by hand.
